now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 109, May is stranded in 2091 with the team, and she and Coulson finally admit their feelings.

proposed.text: In episode 105, back in the present after being stranded in 2091, May tells Coulson she loves him.

changes.evidence: The 2091 arc ends by episode 98 (S5E10); May confesses her love to Coulson at the Lighthouse in "The Honeymoon" (AoS S5E17 = episode 105), not in episode 109 and not in 2091.

now.title: Daredevil S2
now.text: In episode 12, Ellison helps Karen dig into the Punisher and gives her a job at the Bulletin.

proposed.text: In episode 9, Ellison helps Karen dig into the Punisher and gives her a job at the Bulletin.

changes.evidence: Ellison digs through the Bulletin files with Karen, then offers her Ben Urich's old office and tells her to get to work for the Bulletin in Daredevil S2E9 (Ref DD209), not episode 12.

now.title: The Punisher S1
now.text: In episode 9, Ellison tells Karen he once dropped a hacker story at Homeland's request, then confronts her as the news shows Frank Castle alive.

proposed.text: Ellison tells Karen he once dropped a hacker story at Homeland's request. Later, he confronts her as the news shows Frank Castle alive.

changes.evidence: The hacker (Micro) story and Carson Wolf's request come up in The Punisher S1E2 (Ref TP102); the news that Frank Castle is alive is in S1E9 (Ref TP109). The record pins both to episode 9.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 86, Piper serves on May's strike team, then helps Daisy and Simmons into the Framework aboard the Zephyr.

proposed.text: In episode 81, Piper escapes the burning Playground on the Zephyr and helps log Daisy and Simmons into the Framework.

changes.evidence: Piper helps log Daisy and Simmons into the Framework aboard Zephyr One in "Self Control" (AoS S4E15 = episode 81, Ref AoS415). In episode 86 (AoS420) she is only waiting on the Zephyr as power runs out.

now.title: Agent Carter
now.text: In episode 8, Agent Krzeminski belittles Peggy until Dottie Underwood kills him.

proposed.text: In episode 3, Agent Krzeminski belittles Peggy until Dottie Underwood kills him.

changes.evidence: Krzeminski is shot dead by the assassin after a staged car crash while driving Zandow in Agent Carter S1E3 "Time and Tide" (Ref AC103), not episode 8. Peggy only names Dottie as the killer later (AC106), so the owner may also want the name dropped (F7).

now.title: Daredevil S3
now.text: In episode 12, Agent Ray Nadeem works Fisk's deal, then learns the truth and turns on him with Matt's help.

proposed.text: In episode 11, Agent Ray Nadeem works Fisk's deal, then learns the truth and turns on him with Matt's help.

changes.evidence: Nadeem turns on Fisk in S3E10 (Ref DD310) and allies with Daredevil when Fisk's men attack his home in S3E11 (Ref DD311). His testimony and death are episode 12 (DD312), which is k1. Both records are now labeled episode 12.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 110, back in the present, young Robin draws again to help May find Coulson, and the team saves her from Talbot.

proposed.text: In episode 110, Robin survives the crash of Talbot's ship in Chicago, runs to May, and senses that the doomed future has changed.

changes.evidence: Robin draws the clue to Coulson in AoS S5E16 (episode 104) and is saved from Talbot at the Lighthouse in S5E18 (episode 106). Episode 110 (AoS522) is the Chicago crash, where May finds her and Robin senses the timeline has changed.

owner_calls.question: k2 marks Robin Deceased for the death of her elderly 2091 self (a future that is later averted), and k3 then shows young present-day Robin active. Should k2 keep the Deceased status?
options: Keep Deceased (it is her death on screen)
Set k2 to Active and keep the death in the text only
Move the 2091 record to a separate variant file
owner_calls.evidence: The elderly Robin who dies is from the Destroyed Earth future of 2091. Present-day Robin is alive throughout and the future is erased in AoS522.

owner_calls.question: k2 shows a young Victoria Hand in the Chronicom-altered 1983 after her death in k1. Is a version from an altered timeline fine in this file?
options: Keep as is (the text says it is a changed 1983)
Move to a variant file (Victoria Hand/History Altered by Chronicoms)
owner_calls.evidence: The 1983 Hand who shoots Garrett (AoS712) and watches Deke take charge (AoS713) is the altered-timeline Hand, a separate fandom page. The record itself is accurate.
